  )
)

items.question: 在 2026-06-30 的快照中，哪些產品三個倉庫加總的庫存低於安全庫存的 3 倍？
items.sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(i.on_hand_qty) AS total_qty FROM marts.fct_inventory AS i JOIN marts.dim_products AS p USING (product_id) JOIN marts.dim_warehouses AS w USING (warehouse_id) WHERE i.snapshot_date = CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.product_name, p.safety_stock HAVING SUM(i.on_hand_qty) < 3 * p.safety_stock LIMIT 1000

items.question: 2025 年哪一個月的未取消訂單數最多？
items.sql: SELECT order_month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM marts.fct_sales WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: 北區倉 SSD-C1T-G4 從 2026 年 1 月到 6 月每個月底的庫存是多少？
items.sql: SELECT w.warehouse_name, i.snapshot_date, i.on_hand_qty FROM marts.fct_inventory AS i JOIN marts.dim_warehouses AS w USING (warehouse_id) JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.sku = 'SSD-C1T-G4' AND w.warehouse_name = '北區倉' ORDER BY i.snapshot_date LIMIT 1000

items.question: 已出貨的訂單從下單到出貨平均要幾天？
items.sql:
SELECT AVG(datediff(ship_date, order_date)) AS avg_days_to_ship
FROM marts.fct_sales
WHERE status = 'shipped'

items.question: 2026 年各客戶類型的毛利率由高到低是多少？
items.sql: SELECT c.customer_name, c.segment, AVG(s.gross_margin) AS avg_gross_margin FROM marts.fct_sales AS s JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c USING (customer_id) WHERE s.status <> 'cancelled' AND s.order_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND s.order_date < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.customer_name, c.segment ORDER BY avg_gross_margin DESC LIMIT 1000
